mechanism: The reduction of {{signal}} intensity or {{value}} magnitude in response to resistance or {{noise}}. It acts as a negative feedback loop to prevent oscillation or runaway amplification.
gloss: Passive attenuation of signal or force
invariants: Attenuation does not decrease as the resistance or {{noise}} that triggered it increases.
A Dampen never increases the {{signal}} it is applied to.
failure_modes: Signal lost with the noise: the trigger is {{noise}} and the response is on magnitude, so an undiscriminating Dampen attenuates the {{value}} too.
Damping the correction: applied to the control signal rather than the disturbance, it stabilises at the wrong value.
